sources.bpa: gov.mb.ca Personal Tax Credits: BPA $15,780 for 2024 and 2025; credits at 10.8%
sources.phase_out: gov.mb.ca Personal Tax Credits: effective 2025, the Manitoba BPA is phased out over net income $200,000 to $400,000
sources.renters: gov.mb.ca Personal Tax Credits: Renters Affordability Tax Credit up to $625 for the 2026 tax year (Budget 2025 p.140)
sources.homeowners: gov.mb.ca Personal Tax Credits: Homeowners Affordability Tax Credit up to $1,600 for the 2026 tax year (principal residence)
